brief_rationale: The trajectory built a largely practical plan for no independent weight-bearing, bedpan/lighting/fall prevention, phone confirmation, community sterile dressing changes, wheelchair transport, and follow-up. However, responsibility-chain errors remain: red-flag/teach-back closure was incomplete, medication safety was not fully核对ed with dose/no NSAID-mixing cautions, and the doctor introduced a side/certainty error by calling the suspected cuneiform injury “右足楔骨撕脱骨折.” Under the frozen rubric, any minor/moderate responsibility-chain error caps the grade at 2 despite substantial later mitigation and high-order strengths.
